name: How do you choose the right paint colors and finishes for my home during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do you choose the right paint colors and finishes for my home during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing paint colors and finishes involves considering your home's existing elements, natural light, and desired aesthetic. Frasheski Construction offers guidance on selecting colors that complement your furnishings and architectural style, and finishes that suit the function of each room. For instance, a durable, washable finish might be ideal for high-traffic areas. We can provide samples to help visualize choices in your home's unique lighting conditions, ensuring satisfaction with the final look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choosing paint colors involves considering existing elements, lighting, and desired aesthetic. Frasheski Construction helps select colors and finishes that suit your home and room function.
